name: Valley of the Kings
summary: Egyptian nobles deck-build and entomb artifacts to score the most valuable tomb.
rules_text: Each player starts with 10 starter cards shuffled as a draw deck and 5 cards in hand. A shared pyramid of 6 face-up cards is dealt from a stock made of Level II cards stacked on Level III. On your turn you may, in any order, play cards from hand for gold to buy cards from the base row of the pyramid, play cards for their actions, and entomb at most one card to your tomb for end-game points. Bought cards go to your discard. After buying, the pyramid crumbles: cards diagonal above slide down to fill gaps. Then discard all remaining hand and in-play cards to your discard pile, refill the pyramid from stock starting at the base, and draw 5 new cards, shuffling discard when deck empties. If you changed nothing, you must discard one pyramid card to the boneyard. Play clockwise until stock is empty; highest VP in tomb wins.
rating_reason: Deckbuilding tomb stocking, hidden deck, turn-based scoring
